CA.rationale: No attention/allocation/content-processing condition explicitly linked to content organization; A absent.

COD.rationale: C and D are explicitly present for p1/current/n2; an organization/presentation pattern is signalled by grouped coordinate lists but the O-role here is partly coordinate-only (borderline), so binding-level status is ambiguous.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to content organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (named pX/current/nY) with attributes (red/blue) are present.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields (e.g. kind, executed_branch_claim) are provided separately from the content coordinate lists, distinguishing identity from status.

O.rationale: The report states display orientation explicitly and shows grouped coordinate lists for contents, indicating presentation/organization.
